A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the beamforming schemes for AF and DF methods can achieve the maximum possible diversity order of 2 and 3, respectively.

, the diversity order can be increased with the help of beamforming schemes for both AF and decode and forward relay channels, and the diversity order can also be increased for DF with the help of quantized feedback.
, for the relay channels with quantized feedback, AF method is superior to DF method, especially when the number of bits for quantizing the phase information of the channel is small.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the diversity order of the relay systems can be increased by using quantized beamforming at the relays.
the diversity order is not affected by the quantization of the feedback information, as long as the number of bits is sufficient.

, the beamforming schemes for AF and DF relay systems are quite similar to the ones used in the point-to-point systems, and that quantizing the relay-destination channels to the relays does not significantly affect the performance of the relay systems.
